options.name: cypher_path
options.description: Specify a full Cypher mount and key path.

options.name: length
options.description: Required if O(mount) is either V(key) or V(password) For O(mount=key) specify the bit length for the generated key. For O(mount=password) specify the character length for the generated password. Mutually exclusive with O(cypher_path).

options.name: mount
options.description: Specify the Cypher mount point. Mutually exclusive with O(cypher_path).

options.name: name
options.description: Specify the Key Name. Required when O(mount) is specified. Mutually exclusive with O(cypher_path).

options.name: ttl
options.description: Specify the lease duration either in seconds or human readable format, e.g 15m, 8h, 7d.

options.name: value
options.description: Specify the data to be stored when O(mount) is either V(secret) or V(tfvars). Required when O(mount) is either V(secret) or V(tfvars).
